name: qti
label: IMS Global QTI (Assessment)
description: Question and Test Interoperability — standardized assessment/exam data
short_description: Question and Test Interoperability — standardized assessment/exam data
long_description: IMS QTI (Question and Test Interoperability) 3.0 is the global standard for assessment content. The schema covers item banks for storing questions with interaction types (multiple choice, fill-in-blank, hot spot), test definitions with timing and attempt rules, and attempt records with learner responses and scores.
when_to_use: Use for assessment platforms, exam management systems, or any edtech tool that creates/delivers tests. Used by major testing organizations (Educational Testing Service, Pearson Vue, JAMB) for question bank management. Required for integration with IMS-certified LMS platforms. Essential for adaptive testing systems.

table_notes.qti_item_bank: Named collection grouping related assessment items; acts as a folder/namespace for items sharing a subject, course, or owner.
table_notes.qti_item: Core assessment item record storing the question content, interaction type, scored choices, and metadata such as difficulty and point value.
table_notes.qti_test: Test definition combining timing rules, attempt limits, shuffle behaviour, and pass threshold — the blueprint a candidate receives.
table_notes.qti_test_item: Join table linking items to tests with explicit ordering, optional section grouping, and per-item score weighting.
table_notes.qti_attempt: Single candidate sitting of a test, capturing start/submit timestamps, all item responses, computed score, and pass/fail outcome.

qti_item_bank.name: id
qti_item_bank.description: Surrogate primary key for the item bank

qti_item_bank.name: title
qti_item_bank.description: Human-readable name of the item bank (e.g. 'Algebra I — Unit 3')

qti_item_bank.name: description
qti_item_bank.description: Free-text description of the bank's scope, subject, or intended audience

qti_item_bank.name: owner_id
qti_item_bank.description: References the user/organization that owns and administers this bank

qti_item_bank.name: created_at
qti_item_bank.description: Timestamp when the bank was created (UTC)

qti_item.name: id
qti_item.description: Surrogate primary key for the assessment item

qti_item.name: bank_id
qti_item.description: References qti_item_bank — the collection this item belongs to

qti_item.name: identifier
qti_item.description: QTI spec identifier string (unique within a bank, used for IMS import/export)

qti_item.name: title
qti_item.description: Short title or stem summary shown in item-bank management UIs

qti_item.name: interaction_type
qti_item.description: QTI interaction type: choiceInteraction, textEntryInteraction, hotspotInteraction, etc.

qti_item.name: prompt
qti_item.description: Full question text presented to the candidate, may contain HTML/MathML

qti_item.name: choices
qti_item.description: Array of answer options: [{identifier, content, fixed}] — used for choice/order interactions

qti_item.name: correct_response
qti_item.description: Expected answer(s): {cardinality, value} following QTI responseDeclaration format

qti_item.name: feedback
qti_item.description: Per-choice or modal feedback: {correct: '...', incorrect: '...', perChoice: {id: msg}}

qti_item.name: tags
qti_item.description: Flat array of taxonomy or curriculum tags (e.g. ['bloom:apply', 'ccss:6.EE.A.1'])

qti_item.name: difficulty
qti_item.description: Item difficulty parameter in [0,1] (higher = easier, per IRT p-value convention)

qti_item.name: points
qti_item.description: Maximum raw score awarded for a fully correct response to this item

qti_test.name: id
qti_test.description: Surrogate primary key for the test definition

qti_test.name: title
qti_test.description: Display title shown to candidates on the test cover page

qti_test.name: description
qti_test.description: Administrative description of the test's purpose, scope, and target population

qti_test.name: time_limit_minutes
qti_test.description: Maximum minutes allowed per attempt; NULL means untimed

qti_test.name: max_attempts
qti_test.description: Number of attempts a candidate may make before being locked out

qti_test.name: shuffle_items
qti_test.description: When true, item order is randomised per attempt to reduce answer sharing

qti_test.name: pass_score
qti_test.description: Minimum score required to mark the attempt as passed; NULL disables pass/fail logic

qti_test.name: total_points
qti_test.description: Sum of all item point values — used to normalise percentage scores

qti_test.name: instructions
qti_test.description: Candidate-facing instructions displayed before the test begins

qti_test_item.name: id
qti_test_item.description: Surrogate primary key for the test-item association

qti_test_item.name: test_id
qti_test_item.description: References qti_test — the test this item is included in

qti_test_item.name: item_id
qti_test_item.description: References qti_item — the item being included in the test

qti_test_item.name: seq_num
qti_test_item.description: 1-based display order of this item within its section (or the whole test)

qti_test_item.name: section
qti_test_item.description: Optional section/part label grouping items (e.g. 'Part A', 'Reading Comprehension')

qti_test_item.name: weight
qti_test_item.description: Multiplier applied to the item's raw score when computing the test total

qti_attempt.name: id
qti_attempt.description: Surrogate primary key for the candidate attempt

qti_attempt.name: test_id
qti_attempt.description: References qti_test — the test definition this attempt is against

qti_attempt.name: candidate_id
qti_attempt.description: References the learner/candidate in the application's user table

qti_attempt.name: started_at
qti_attempt.description: UTC timestamp when the candidate began the attempt

qti_attempt.name: submitted_at
qti_attempt.description: UTC timestamp when the candidate submitted (NULL if still in progress)

qti_attempt.name: score
qti_attempt.description: Computed total score after all item responses are graded

qti_attempt.name: passed
qti_attempt.description: True if score >= qti_test.pass_score; NULL if test has no pass threshold

qti_attempt.name: responses
qti_attempt.description: Map of item responses: {item_id: {response, score, time_spent_seconds}}

qti_attempt.name: feedback
qti_attempt.description: Per-item feedback delivered to the candidate: {item_id: {text, correct}}
